coordinateRules: Coordinates are actual returned official BC Address Geocoder parcel points, not invented building centroids.
Only CIVIC_NUMBER precision with identity-matched operator address is accepted; BLOCK and street/locality-only results are rejected.
Historical address parcel references describe address context, not historical building or asset geometry. Replacement project targets remain separate.
